interactions: Desktop rail and mobile drawer link to four routes; active route uses aria-current.
SEO tabs retain site/page/compare API values; Radix controls own tab keyboard behavior.
URLs normalize to HTTPS; Page analysis accepts up to five keywords.
Streaming analysis disables inputs, supports cancellation, and replaces progress with evidence reports.
UX requires one primary persona and allows two distinct comparison personas.
Feedback persists only in a versioned browser-local store; user corrections remain reviewable.
Export menu supports PDF, current-tab CSV and copied spreadsheet-safe tables.
Dialogs trap focus, close on Escape and return focus to their trigger.
Manual feedback corrections persist as drafts across reloads; editing clears the previous reviewed status. Route changes restore the workspace heading to the top.
Optional Supabase email-link sign-in unlocks a private Postgres persona library, with create, edit and confirmed delete actions.
Audit selectors merge examples and owned saved personas; at most two distinct comparisons can be checked. Deleting the selected primary restores Lucy and removes any duplicate comparison.
Custom personas use monogram avatars. Examples are labelled Example by known ID, independent of the core persona flag.
Signing out clears the private library and current report/rerun payload. Deleting a persona preserves existing report snapshots.
Mutation dialogs disable controls while saving; errors preserve the editable form and do not imply database success.
Radix dialogs trap focus and use generated title associations; controlled dialogs restore the actual opener.
Export menu supports arrow-key navigation and returns focus to its trigger.
Mobile navigation uses an explicit left placement variant, avoiding centered translate utilities; its 300px panel remains on-screen in the production build.
Header GitHub link opens Behzad85/page-signal in a new tab; exact live star count refreshes every five minutes while visible, with loading and unavailable states.

seededData.reports: No fabricated seeded metrics; demo actions fetch live public targets.
